topic: How should residents discuss a proposal for wind turbines near their town?
essay:
Wind turbines are modern and modern things usually make places successful. Our town should have the turbines because they are tall and show that people are looking forward. Anyone who disagrees is probably afraid of change. Public discussion should therefore begin by explaining that the decision is already the right one. Spending too long listening to objections will only make the town seem uncertain.

The turbines would look impressive on the hills. A visitor might see them from the road and think the town is active and interesting. People often take photographs of large structures, so this would certainly bring many tourists. When tourists arrive, every local business will do well. There is no reason to calculate how many visitors might come because being optimistic is more important than worrying about numbers.

Some residents mention noise, wildlife, electricity connections, or who receives the income. These are different subjects and should not distract from the fact that renewable energy is a good idea. If something is good in general, it must be good in this particular location. The people planning the project are experts, and experts would not make a mistake. This means independent information would be an unnecessary expense.

The town also needs a better football pitch and a new sign outside the station. These improvements would make everyone proud of living here. The wind project is a chance to talk about all the things that could be better, including shops staying open later and more flowers near the square. Good discussion means keeping everyone positive about the town. Complaints should be saved for another meeting.

In conclusion, residents should support the turbines and finish the discussion quickly. A confident town makes confident decisions. If any problems appear afterward, somebody can deal with them then. There is no need to compare alternative locations or arrangements now because that might weaken support for an exciting project. The future belongs to places that say yes.
